title: Triangles seen on launch pads at Groom Lake

tellings.quote: I I know numerous people who have have seen triangles on launch pads at at Groom Lake

plain: A researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb, speaking with a podcast host named Jesse Michels, says he knows many people who have seen triangle-shaped craft sitting on launch pads at Groom Lake, a secret test site in Nevada often called Area 51. He gives no dates and names no witnesses on air. If true, it would suggest that unusual triangular craft are kept and flown at a guarded government base.
